name: Games&Girls
source:
The protagonist is a gamer who dropped out of college to have more time to play video games. He used all his savings to buy an exclusive gaming console, called Sirrah. He has a lot of fun with the console even if he has nothing else left. One day, he wakes up and sees a strange but cute girl in his room. It turns out that the girl is his beloved console Sirrah! What will happen to them?!

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/yucr005/gamesandgirls/]JAST USA[/url]]
